key_points: Q2 earnings beat expectations but FY26 guidance cut, indicating near‑term revenue pressure.
UBS and HP management warn of a mid‑single‑digit decline in PC volumes for 2027, reflecting a broader market slowdown.
Rising memory and component costs further squeeze margins and demand.
Analyst commentary (Morgan Stanley, UBS) highlights unit and margin pressures not fully priced yet.
Minor positive note: Andra AP fund purchase and undervaluation commentary, but likely outweighed by downside news.
